analysis_complete.description: Complete code analysis and generate JSON output with structured findings
analysis_complete.docstring:
Complete the code analysis session by generating a structured JSON output.

This command validates and saves your analysis results in JSON format, then terminates the session.

Options:
  -o, --output OUTPUT_FILE    Specify output JSON file path (default: /root/analysis.json)
  -f, --force                Force completion without validation stages

The command expects a JSON structure with analysis_summary, relevant_files, potential_root_causes, recommended_investigation_order, related_test_files, and dependencies.
